senses.gloss: m.Darosah (Wine-Treader), name of a coin, = 1¾ As.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kiddushin 1:1:24">Y. Kidd. I, 58ᵈ</cite>; Bab.

Kidd. 12ᵃ הַדְּרֵיס; Tosef. B. Bath. V, 12 הַדְּרֵס.—Pl. דּוֹרְסִים. Y. l. c. ג׳ ד׳ למעה (Bab. l. c. הַדְּרֵיסִין; Tosef. l. c. הַדְּרֵסִין) three d. make one M’ah. [V. legends of Jewish coins in Conder Handbook to the Bible, 3ʳᵈ ed., p. 177, sq.]
